INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF SCIENCE
PROGRAM       BACHELOR OF SCIENCE (CHEMISTRY)
SEMESTER         3
COURSE TITLE   CAREER READINESS PROGRAMME
COURSE CODE     02CR0301
COURSE CREDITS  2


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Express ideas and information effectively.
 2  Deduce conclusions from various forms of data including text and speech.
 3  Choose appropriate alternatives in personal and professional life.
 4  Act in accordance with one’s own strength.


Pre-requisite of course:Before studying Career Readiness Program, all students are expected to
have basic understanding/knowledge of English language

                        Teaching and Examination Scheme
 Theory      Tutorial      Practical   ESE    IA    CSE     Viva     Term
  Hours      Hours       Hours                               Work
     2            0            0         0      0       0        50         50

 Contents :                                                             Contact                                       Topics    Unit                                                          Hours
     1       Linguistic of Interaction                                   30
               Introduction of subject, Self Discipline, Self Mastery, Beating Self
              Sabotage, Building Self Confidence, Golden Rules of Goal Setting,
            Backward Goal Setting, Visualization, Half Time Review, Breaking
           Bad Habits, Developing Resilience, The Betari Box, Managing
              Yourself, Active Listening Skills, A Good Role Model, Group
              Discussion, Word Class:- Noun , Determiners, Word Class :-
               Adjectives, Collocation, Word Class :- Prepposition , Conjunction,
             Phonology:- Study of Sounds, Phonetics & Pronunciation:-
               Articulation of Sound, CCE-1, READ COMPREHENSION:-
          PROCESSING STRATEGY, Syntax :- Tenses -1, Syntax :- Tenses
                 -2, Syntax :- Tenses -3, CCE-2, Syntax :- VOICES - forms &
             Usage, SPOKEN DISCOURSE:- Conversation practice & Role play
                               Total Hours                       30

Textbook :
 1  Longman Student Grammar of Spoken and Written English, Biber Douglas, Pearson
    Education India, 2002

References:
 1  High School English Grammar and Composition, High School English Grammar and
    Composition, P.C. WREN, and H. MARTIN, S Chand , 2019
 2  Longman Student Grammar of Spoken and Written English, Longman Student Grammar of
    Spoken and Written English, Biber Douglas, Pearson Education India, 2002

Suggested Theory Distribution:
The suggested theory distribution as per Bloom’s taxonomy is as follows. This distribution
serves as guidelines for teachers and students to achieve effective teaching-learning process

                   Distribution of Theory for course delivery and evaluation

 Remember /   Understand     Apply       Analyze      Evaluate   Higher order
 Knowledge                                                         Thinking
    20.00         30.00         25.00         25.00         10.00          0.00

Instructional Method:
 1  The course delivery method will include interaction, class work, demonstration, role play,
     quiz and brain storming.
 2  The internal evaluation will be done based on continuous evaluation of students in the class
     -room.
 3  Practical/viva examination will be conducted at the end of semester for evaluation of
    performance of students.

Supplementary Resources:
 1  https://www.grammarly.com/i
 2   http://englishteststore.net/
 3  http://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/en/english-grammar
 4  https://www.englishclub.com/grammar/
 5  http://www.perfect-english-grammar.com/
